mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, routing_key, payload, created_at, sent_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{routingKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, routing_key, payload::text AS payload, created_at, sent_at FROM outbox_events WHERE sent_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM processed_events WHERE consumer = #{consumer} AND event_id = #{eventId})
WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO processed_events (consumer, event_id, processed_at) VALUES (#{consumer}, #{eventId}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
